content_sections.heading: About HP Home Guards
content_sections.text: The Department of Home Guards, Civil Defence & Fire Services is a department of the Himachal Pradesh government. Its Director General's office is at US Club, Shimla. This post is in that department.

content_sections.heading: HP Home Guards Junior Office Assistant (IT) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must be at least 18 and no more than 45 years old on the last date for receiving applications. The upper age limit can be relaxed by up to 5 years, as per the instructions of the Himachal Pradesh government. Only Orthopedically Handicapped (OH) candidates can apply. You need a permanent disability of at least 40%. This must be shown on a Disability Certificate issued by the competent Medical Board, which means the District Medical Board. If you are selected, the certificate will be checked by the competent authority. You must be a bona fide resident of Himachal Pradesh, certified by the Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil), Tehsildar or Naib-Tehsildar. You must have passed the 10+2 Examination from a recognized Board of School Education or University. OR Matriculation from a recognized Board of School Education with a one or two year Diploma or Certificate from an Industrial Training Institute (ITI) in Information Technology (IT) Enabled Sectors (ITES), as notified by the Director General of Employment & Training (Govt. of India) from time to time. Another option is a three-year Diploma in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or IT from a Polytechnic approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Computer typing speed of 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi. Differently abled candidates who are otherwise qualified for a clerical post, and whom the Medical Board certifies as unable to type, may be excused from the typing test. This applies only where a physical disability or deformity permanently prevents the person from typing. The same exemption also covers the Skill Test Norms on Computers. Eligibility for the essential qualification is judged as on the last date for applications. Knowledge of the customs, manners and dialects of Himachal Pradesh, and suitability for appointment in the peculiar conditions prevailing in HP. The official notification gives the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written exam. Selection is based only on the documents you send with your application form. The department awards weightage marks for these documents under the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, HP letter No. SJE-B-B(15)-03/2014-1 dated 28 August 2017. These are the criteria the notice prints clearly: Other items on the application form also count towards merit. These are a non-employment certificate for the family, widow, divorced, destitute or single woman status, single daughter or orphan status, and a training certificate of at least 6 months related to the post. The weightage table in the official notification gives their marks. Candidates are called for evaluation and screening in a ratio of 1:10 for the first post, and 1:5 for each further post. The date of document evaluation and verification will be sent to you by post and also put on the department's website. You must bring all original certificates to verification. If you do not, your candidature will be cancelled.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for this Junior Office Assistant (IT) post?
faq.answer: Only Orthopedically Handicapped candidates who are bona fide residents of Himachal Pradesh and have a permanent disability of 40% or more.

faq.question: Q2. Is there a written exam or interview?
faq.answer: No. A merit list is made from weightage marks, with a maximum total of 30, given for your qualification, disability percentage and social and economic certificates. Your documents are then verified.

faq.question: Q3. What typing speed is needed?
faq.answer: 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi. A candidate whom the Medical Board certifies as unable to type may be exempted.

faq.question: Q4. How are marks given for disability?
faq.answer: A disability of 40% to 59% gets 2 marks, 60% to 79% gets 4 marks, and 80% to 100% gets 6 marks.

faq.question: Q5. How much age relaxation is allowed?
faq.answer: The upper age limit of 45 years can be relaxed by up to 5 years, as per HP government instructions.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a regular post?
faq.answer: The post is filled as a Job Trainee under the Government's Job Trainee Policy, with fixed monthly emoluments of Rs. 12,500/-.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Send it by registered post, or take it by hand, to The Director General, Home Guards & Civil Defence, US Club, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh 171001.

faq.question: Q8. How many candidates will be called for screening?
faq.answer: Candidates are called in a ratio of 1:10 for the first post.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for document verification?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be admissible.
